name: Liquid equity rewards

subjectOf.text: Liquid Equity Rewards (LER) is a voucher rewards mechanism that links capital formation to loyalty rewards by granting time-weighted, utility-only rewards to holders of equities or cryptoassets.
subjectOf.abstract: This article evaluates the prospects of Liquid Equity Rewards (LER), a voucher rewards mechanism linking capital formation and loyalty rewards through time-weighted, utility-only rewards for holders of equities or cryptoassets.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054

subjectOf.text: Liquid Equity Rewards is defined as a blockchain enabled system that grants verified holders of stock or tokenized equity time-weighted, utility-only rewards rather than financial yield.
subjectOf.abstract: A blockchain-enabled system called Liquid Equity Rewards (LER) provides verified holders of stocks or tokenized assets with time-weighted, utility-only rewards.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards in Corporate America (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5583610
